title: Creamy Portuguese Pasta
description: A rich and creamy pasta dish inspired by Portuguese flavors. This recipe combines the tanginess of zesty pasta with the creaminess of a traditional Portuguese sauce.
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the penne pasta according to package instructions.
In a large skillet, melt the butter over medium heat.
Add the zesty pasta sauce and stir to combine.
Bring the sauce to a simmer and let cook for 2-3 minutes.
Stir in the shredded Portuguese cheese until melted and smooth.
Add the cooked penne pasta to the skillet and toss with the sauce until well coated.
If using heavy cream, stir it in at this point to add extra creaminess.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
